name: blu
description: The BLU App connects your BLU leadership information with conversational AI to help you stay focused, aligned, and accountable. Review company information, initiatives, targets, and individual goals; explore progress over time; and make progress updates without manually moving information between systems. Add or remove items from your Weekly Game Plan, create 30-60-90 day plans based on your priorities, and access files stored in BLU. It brings planning, progress tracking, and everyday action together through simple requests in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: The BLU App connects your BLU leadership information with conversational AI to help you stay focused, aligned, and accountable. Review company information, initiatives, targets, and individual goals; explore progress over time; and make progress updates without manually moving information between systems. Add or remove items from your Weekly Game Plan, create 30-60-90 day plans based on your priorities, and access files stored in BLU. It brings planning, progress tracking, and everyday action together through simple requests in ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Update a BLU target progress entry

positive.description: Review and adjust the active BLU context.
positive.prompt: Show my current BLU organization, company, and fiscal year, then switch me to the ABC Company team for fiscal year 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the current context, resolves the requested team, updates the active company and fiscal year, and confirms the new BLU context.

positive.description: Review target status and prepare a confirmed target progress update.
positive.prompt: List my targets, show the latest progress for Revenue Growth, and prepare an August update with goal 100000, actual 92000, status Caution, and note that pipeline timing is delayed.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching targets, shows current progress, and renders a confirmation card before any target progress update is saved.

positive.description: Review initiative progress and prepare an initiative update.
positive.prompt: Show my initiatives for 2026, open the progress for Customer Onboarding, and prepare a July update marked On Schedule with a short success statement.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists initiatives, returns the selected initiative progress, and shows a confirmation card for the proposed update.

positive.description: Read and update the weekly game plan.
positive.prompt: Show this week's BLU weekly game plan and add a todo item to follow up on the leadership scorecard.
positive.expected_behavior: Renders the current weekly game plan widget for the direct show request, then renders a weekly game plan confirmation widget with the proposed item added.

positive.description: Find and summarize a BLU file.
positive.prompt: Find the BLU Playbook PDF and summarize its main ideas and practical takeaways.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves one accessible BLU Playbook file, reads enough bounded content for a reliable summary, and summarizes only the returned file content.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar scheduling. The app should not be invoked because it does not create calendar events or manage scheduling outside BLU workflows.
negative.prompt: Schedule a meeting with my team tomorrow at 3 PM.

negative.description: Do not trigger for general public web research. The app should not be invoked because the request is public web research rather than a BLU workspace action.
negative.prompt: Find recent news articles about leadership training trends.

negative.description: Do not trigger for non-BLU file storage requests. The app should not be invoked because the request is for an external file storage and sharing service rather than BLU Files.
negative.prompt: Upload this PDF to my Google Drive and share it with the leadership team.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes:
Introducing the BLU ChatGPT App.
Access your BLU organization, initiatives, targets, individual goals, weekly game plans, and files directly through ChatGPT. Review and update progress, manage weekly priorities, create 30-60-90 day plans, and work with your BLU information through simple conversational requests.
